headings.text: الإنصات والتعبير عن الأفكار وفهم الآخر.
الإنصات والتعبير عن الأفكار وفهم الآخر.

findings.message: 2 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "جمعية شابا كونكت" above "اختياراتك، طريقك."; "جمعية شابا كونكت" above "لتعرف نفسك أكثر."
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.
Prefer a filled surface or no box.
Use the drawn palette. If you want warmth, take a low-chroma stone or bone, not a yellow cream.
Raise contrast to at least 4.5:1 for text, 3:1 for large display.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: Body text is 14px (the size most of the running text is set in).
findings.fix: Body copy 16–20px. Map small sizes from blueprints onto your body step.

findings.message: The running text is a soft grey on its ground (5.6:1).
findings.fix: Set body copy in the full ink (7:1 or more). Keep the muted ink for secondary notes; pages read thin and unfinished when everything is grey.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.
Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

findings.message: Left-aligned text starts at 12 different lines (114px, 125px, 147px, 249px, 825px, 889px, 970px); the three most used hold only 23% of it.
findings.fix: Pick two or three anchor lines from the grid and start every heading and paragraph on one of them.

findings.message: Little motion: 13 element(s) moved while the page loaded and scrolled.
findings.fix: Give every section an entrance for its parts (not one fade of the whole block) and add one moving picture: a looping clip or a slow move on a photograph.

findings.message: The h1 is a bare name ("اختياراتك، طريقك.") and nothing else on the first screen says what this is.
findings.fix: Keep the name if it leads, and give the line under it (18px or more) the plain words: what it is, for whom, where or when. In the study of 97 Sites of the Day, first screens that named nothing lost usability and content points.

findings.message: Large text lies under another element at some scroll position: "مؤشرات، بحدود واضحة." (screen 6, 75% hidden); "خطوتك القادمة تبدأ هنا." (screen 8, 25% hidden)
findings.fix: Nothing may sit on top of a headline or statement. Move the picture, shorten the pinned run, or raise the text above it (z-index) and give it a ground.
